description: Search policies and defaults only. Category meanings, aliases and price tiers are defined in categories.json. Restart the backend after edits. Explicit user constraints take precedence. Schema capabilities and security ceilings remain in code; deployment/model settings remain in .env.

coverage.description: Only records connected through an Area to this City are supported. Search-radius expansion never extends city coverage. Unknown place names are not proof that a place is outside the city.

alternatives.description: After an empty discovery search, expand only a system-default nearby radius. Explicit food, price, numeric distance, amenities and other requirements remain fixed until the user changes them. Explain every expansion.

results.description: Explicit counts override defaults, including answer size. Maximum 25 is the code safety ceiling.

proximity.description: Straight-line distance over available dataset records. Explicit distance wins, then an explicit mode, then venue/general defaults. A larger radius does not extend dataset coverage.

ranking.description: Rating means highest average_rating; popularity means highest review_count, not visits or sales; price means lowest restaurant avg_price; distance means shortest straight-line distance and requires coordinates. Best/top rated ranks only places with at least rated_minimum_reviews reviews; this default is loosened when nothing matches.

price_matching.currency_note: Missing restaurant price currency uses MYR for the current Petaling Jaya dataset. Recorded currencies take precedence. Missing min/max remain unknown, never copied from averages.
